events.title: BLINDFOLD Demo — Full-Version Features for One Week
events.summary: For a limited time, we're bringing some exclusive full-version features to the BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase Demo For one week only, all demo players can enjoy the following features, normally available only in the full version: Temporarily Unlocked FeaturesMap Switching & Rotation — Explore different maps and enjoy more variety!Steam Cloud Support — Keep your progress synced with Steam Cloud.Steam Nicknames — Display your Steam nickname instead of a temporary nickname.Available for One Week OnlyThese

events.title: New Update (1.1) :: Real-Time Sound Occlusion Update
events.summary: Hello, players! A new update for BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase is now live.This update introduces a new Real-Time Sound Occlusion System, designed to make sound feel more natural and immersive during gameplay. Previously, sounds could be heard at a similar volume even when walls or other obstacles were between players. events.title: BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase – Official Release Date Announced!
events.summary: Hello, this is BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase.We’re excited to announce that BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase will officially launch the day after Steam Next Fest ends!Thank you to everyone who has shown interest in the game and played the demo during Steam Next Fest.The full version will be available for $5.99 USD, with a 15% launch discount for the first 7 days after release.We hope you enjoy the full release of BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase.Thank you for your support, and see you at launch!
